CBSA.CICSBSA.ABNDFILE.recovery_why: etc/install/base/installjcl/BANK.csd: DEFINE FILE(ABNDFILE) ... RECOVERY(NONE) -- the abend log a backout must not undo

scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0 at a terminal with upper-case translation on (UCTRAN): STORE-TERM-DEF INQUIREs UCTRANST, keeps it and SETs NOUCTRAN; the map sent ERASE; RETURN TRANSID('ODCS') LENGTH(266) with the stored CVDA in WS-COMM-TERM

scenarios.name: inquire
scenarios.why: ENTER with customer 1: RECEIVE MAP ... TERMINAL ASIS (lower case kept, X28), BIF DEEDIT, LINK INQCUST (run in the task: READ FILE('CUSTOMER') by the program's own sort code) -- the customer shown, name, address split into three lines, dates and credit score

scenarios.name: delete-customer
scenarios.why: PF5 with customer 1 (three accounts): VALIDATE-DATA passes, DEL-CUST-DATA LINKs DELCUS (INQCUST, INQACCCU, DELACC per account, the CUSTOMER record deleted), COMM-DEL-SUCCESS 'Y' -- the customer-deleted screen

scenarios.name: delete-customer-not-on-file
scenarios.why: PF5 with customer 5, which has an account but no CUSTOMER record: DELCUS returns COMM-DEL-SUCCESS 'N' with INQCUST's fail code '1' -- 'Cust no was not found'

scenarios.name: delete-customer-datastore-error
scenarios.why: INQCUST's READ of CUSTOMER inside DELCUS fails with IOERR: INQCUST's failure code reaches DELCUS and BNK1DCS shows the error message

faults.why: 17 on the first READ of CUSTOMER in the task (INQCUST linked by DELCUS)

notes: CBSA's display / amend / delete-customer screen (BNK1DCS, transaction ODCS, BMS map BNK1DC of mapset BNK1DCM: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1DCM.bms, @bms/BNK1DCM.cpy). Its terminal is a stated fact of the run: T001 (EIBTRMID), UCTRANST NOUCTRAN unless a scenario says UCTRAN (INQUIRE / SET TERMINAL UCTRANST, oracle_assumptions.md X26); a first task stores the terminal's UCTRANST in the COMMAREA and turns translation off, and every exit (PF3 / PF12 / CLEAR, an abend) SETs it back from the COMMAREA (WS-COMM-TERM 451 in every returning scenario). ENTER inquires (LINK INQCUST); PF10 checks the customer and unprotects the name and address for amending (COMM-UPD 'Y'); ENTER with COMM-UPD 'Y' validates the title and address and LINKs UPDCUST; PF5 deletes through DELCUS. INQCUST, UPDCUST and ABNDPROC run in the task, as in cbsa-inqcust / cbsa-updcust. The COMMAREA compared is the one the program RETURNs, WS-COMM-AREA (LENGTH 266). CUSTOMER and ABNDFILE are compared after every scenario. Not reached: a valid PF5 delete -- DELCUS is not translated whole (cics_census: 4 holes), so no scenario LINKs it --; a terminal whose translation is on when a RECEIVE follows the SET (IBM does not say when a SET UCTRANST takes effect: refused by both runtimes, X26), a customer number with no digit after BIF DEEDIT (not modelled), a PF10 whose date / credit-score fields came back empty (UNPROT-CUST-DATA MOVEs the symbolic map's LOW-VALUES through a 9(8) REDEFINES: non-digit data in a numeric MOVE, oracle_assumptions.md C11 -- the scenarios give PF10 the screen's fields as shown), and the failure branches after SEND MAP / SEND TEXT / SEND CONTROL / RETURN / LINK / INQUIRE / SET (no fault can be injected on them). Data: customer.txt is cbsa-updcust's (SYNTHETIC).
